caseNameFull: Voinovich, Governor of Ohio v. Quilter, Speaker Pro Tempore of Ohio House of Representatives

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. N. D. Ohio dismissed. The stay granted by this Court on September 8, 1995 [515 U. S. 1184], is continued pending final disposition by this Court of the appeal in No. 95-378, Voinovich, Governor of Ohio, et al. v. Quilter, Speaker Pro Tempore of Ohio House of Representatives, et al.
